Flaky Fish Meat

Flaky Fish Meat is used in 4 campfire recipes in Red Dead Redemption 2. It comes from 9 animals, including Chain Pickerel, Lake Sturgeon, Largemouth Bass, Muskie and 5 more.

Type
Meat

Animals

  • Chain PickerelBait: Corn
  • Lake SturgeonBait: Lake lures
  • Largemouth BassBait: Crayfish
  • MuskieBait: Lake lures
  • Northern PikeBait: River lures, Worm, Cricket
  • PerchBait: Bread
  • Redfin PickerelBait: Bread
  • Rock BassBait: Cheese
  • Smallmouth BassBait: Cricket

Recipes used in

  • 1x for Minty Flaky FishCampfire
  • 1x for Oregano Flaky FishCampfire
  • 1x for Plain Flaky FishCampfire
  • 1x for Thyme Flaky FishCampfire
